# watchpoint_role (Data Source)

Looks up a single tenant role by name. Returns the scalar role fields only; permissions are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_role" "example" {
  name = "On-Call Engineer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in system-default role.
